'''Kohsuke Tanabe''' (Japanese: '''田邊幸輔''' ''Tanabe Kōsuke'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Tanabe was born in Japan and became a voice actor as an adult. Tanabe first worked on Pokémon, voicing minor characters in ''[[Pokémon: Hisuian Snow]]'' before joining the {{pkmn|animated series}} in {{aniseries|JN}}. Tanabe gained his most notable role during {{aniseries|HZ}}, voicing [[Zirc]] from the [[Explorers]].
